Fans eagerly awaiting a glimpse of Tiger Shroff were thrown into panic. Thankfully, Tiger remained unharmed, yet both his driver and an autorickshaw driver required medical attention. The Lawrence Bishnoi gang has allegedly claimed responsibility, but verification is pending. The Mumbai Crime Branch continues to investigate the incident thoroughly.

title: Dua Lipa takes on Samsung in a $15 million image rights lawsuit
description: Dua Lipa is opposing Samsung’s bid to dismiss her $15 million lawsuit over the alleged unauthorised use of her photograph on television packaging. According to Law Commentary, the singer’s lawyers argue that the image could have falsely suggested she endorsed Samsung’s products. The company disputes the claim, and the court has yet to rule on its dismissal request.

title: Bishnoi gang demands apology from Salman after attack on Tiger
description: In a shocking turn of events, the Lawrence Bishnoi group has taken responsibility for shooting at Tiger Shroff’s vehicle in Mumbai’s Juhu area, having already warned the actor before this assault. Fortunately, while Shroff was unharmed, his driver suffered injuries. Following this alarming incident and related gunfire near Salman Khan's home, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered urgent inquiries to bolster security measures.

title: Aamir Khan meets Raj Thackeray amid Imran Khan's controversy
description: Aamir Khan's recent meeting with Raj Thackeray has sparked curiosity, especially amidst his nephew Imran Khan's troubling legal troubles with Indian authorities. As Imran stands against a notice issued by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office regarding his immigration status, many speculate whether their discussions revolved around these issues. Meanwhile, Imran is seeking assistance from the Bombay High Court for relief related to the notice, intensifying public interest in the situation.

title: Father Jackie Shroff’s team says, 'Tiger Shroff is okay'
description: In a shocking incident in Mumbai's Juhu area, Tiger Shroff's vehicle was fired upon with three bullets. Thankfully, his father, Jackie Shroff, confirmed that Tiger emerged unscathed. However, the attack resulted in injuries to the driver and a bystander, both requiring hospitalization. Authorities swiftly launched an investigation, forming special police teams to track down the assailants, who reportedly claimed the attack was a warning against certain actors.

title: Meet Ashley St. Clair, Elon Musk’s ex who alleges he cut child support
description: Ashley St. Clair, the mother of one of Elon Musk’s children, alleges that the billionaire reduced her child support payments after she refused to sign a $15 million non-disclosure agreement and publicly revealed their son. Musk has disputed her account, denying that such an NDA offer was made. The claims have emerged amid an ongoing custody dispute.

title: Sidhu Moosewala’s 2.5-year-old brother seen making gun gesture, child rights body files complaint in Punjab
description: A complaint has been filed by Lawyers for Human Rights International regarding a toddler's behavior at a concert. Sukhdeep Singh Sidhu, the 2.5-year-old, was seen making gun gestures during a performance in Toronto. Authorities have been asked to investigate and ensure the child's safety at future events. Concerns have been raised about the psychological impact of mimicking firearm gestures at such a young age.

title: Saif Ali Khan reveals he has been attending PTA meetings at same school since he was 20
description: Saif Ali Khan light-heartedly reflected on his extensive journey of attending parent-teacher meetings, starting at 20 and continuing to make appearances at 55. He humorously noted the challenges of managing four kids enrolled at the same institution. Meanwhile, Kareena Kapoor revealed that Saif proposed to her three times before she finally said yes; they have been happily married since 2012, sharing two sons together.

title: Vidyut Jammwal is 'more Dhalsim than Dhalsim', says 'Street Fighter' director
description: In the highly anticipated film Street Fighter, Vidyut Jammwal takes on the role of Dhalsim under the direction of Kitao Sakurai. This adaptation focuses on authenticity and displays Jammwal's impressive martial arts skills to audiences worldwide. Dhalsim has been thoughtfully reimagined to avoid clichés while honoring the source material. Produced by Paramount Pictures and Legendary Entertainment, the film will be available in various languages in India starting October 16.

title: Mukesh Chhabra kisses Samay Raina’s hands in viral clip from theatre festival

Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari, this cinematic marvel will be available in Hindi and Tamil. The first part is scheduled for release on November 5, 2026, and both segments come with an impressive budget of Rs 4,000 crore.

Ganguly also shared a memorable experience with Dharmendra on ‘Ikkis’, revealing that the veteran actor insisted on learning the lyrics and every dance step despite a late-night shoot and poor health. His anecdotes highlight the two actors’ different approaches to performance and their commitment to understanding what each scene demanded.

title: Fact Check: Johnny Lever’s death claim goes viral on social media
description: Recently, a false rumor alleging that beloved actor Johnny Lever has passed away has made rounds on social media. His daughter, Jamie Lever, has brushed off these unsettling claims, emphasizing their baseless nature. Previous investigations have shown no solid evidence to back up the death rumor. Celebrated for his remarkable contributions to Hindi cinema, Johnny is still actively engaged in upcoming projects.

title: Madhuri recalls 5:30 am breakfasts for Dr Shriram Nene
description: Madhuri Dixit moved to the U.S. after marrying Dr. Shriram Nene in 1999. On Simi Garewal’s show, she recalled waking at 5:30 am to make his breakfast before surgeries, savouring every minute. Unaware of her stardom, he hadn’t seen her films. The couple has two sons, and she returned to Bollywood in 2007.

title: Scripting starts for Mirzapur Season 4 as Shweta Tripathi seeks fresh arc for Golu
description: ‘Mirzapur’ Season 4 is in development, with director Gurmmeet Singh confirming that scripting is underway after the success of ‘Mirzapur: The Movie’. Shweta Tripathi, who plays Golu Gupta, says she is eager to explore the character’s continuing evolution. She believes Golu’s experiences have changed her and that they have grown together over the years. According to Mid-Day, the production timeline is expected to be finalised by early 2027, with the story continuing after Season 3’s finale.

title: In 2007, Brad Pitt’s housing mission was meant to rebuild New Orleans; how things went wrong resulted in lawsuits
description: Brad Pitt co-founded the Make It Right Foundation to rebuild homes in New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina. The project aimed to construct affordable and sustainable homes but encountered significant structural issues. Homeowners experienced problems like rotting materials and water damage shortly after moving in. A class-action lawsuit was filed against the foundation for defective construction and fraud. The foundation ultimately agreed to a settlement to reimburse affected homeowners for repairs.

title: In 2022, when the jury ruled in favor of Johnny Depp in a defamation case
description: In a landmark ruling in 2022, Johnny Depp won his defamation case against Amber Heard after a gripping six-week trial that shined a light on domestic abuse issues. The jury awarded Depp $10.35 million, citing Heard's liability for defamation. Following the decision, Heard lamented its implications for women's rights. Meanwhile, both parties have moved forward with out-of-court agreements, allowing Depp to reenter the film industry.

title: ‘Capturing Bigfoot’ Review: An Astounding Documentary Uncovers the Truth
description: "Capturing Bigfoot" is an amazing documentary about the legend of Bigfoot — about how it was born, how it took hold, and how that iconic piece of film footage came to be. It’s a documentary that answers all the questions and solves all the mysteries. Unlike your typical film about UFOs, it doesn’t leave you with that vague feeling of "The truth is still out there, and I’m not sure what it is." "Capturing Bigfoot" shows you the truth, but what it really shows you is what that truth says about us, a society that went down the rabbit hole of wanting to believe and now, increasingly, lives there.
